dt: Complete applications (Job ID 699061 plus 3 letters to herrerafellow@sandia.gov) received through Dec 31, 2026 get full consideration
e: Two-year postdoctoral fellowship (possible third year) for self-directed QIS research (quantum devices, qubit control, error mitigation, algorithms) with Sandia mentors in Albuquerque or Livermore. Requires ability to obtain a DOE security clearance, which requires US citizenship.
n: Sandia: Gil Herrera Fellowship in Quantum Information Science (2027)
